section_summary.extract_value: This section details the factor analysis of the Portuguese Sociocultural Attitudes Toward Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3), identifying four factors: Information, Internalisation–General, Pressures, and Internalisation-Athlete. It also reports on sex differences, finding that women (n=195) had significantly higher scores on Internalisation-General and Pressures compared to men (n=116), with no significant differences for Information and Internalisation-Athlete. Table 3 presents the factor loadings for the items.
